slices.title: Purpose tag on every inference call; side tasks inherit floors
slices.summary: Adds enum InferPurpose (UNSPECIFIED=0 .. SCHEDULED_ROUND=16) and InferRequest.purpose=21 (round A: EP-14 takes run_id=22, EP-13 S4 role_fallback_model=23). inference-core adds a bounded purpose label to inference_requests_total and inference_tokens_total, unknown values count as unspecified. Every non-test InferRequest construction in gateway, execution-core and session-core names a purpose, enforced by a source-text inventory test. subscription_scoped_request is split so inherit_turn_floors always copies privacy-tier and residency floors; CallPhase gains purpose(). Land first in its train, one commit per crate.

slices.title: Replay fake and synthetic cassettes in CI

A test asserts no service lists the crate as a runtime dependency. CI picks up the new test targets. No proto or migration. The matching step may reuse S6's canonicaliser when present, else its own.
